variants.delay1_oas: OAS covariance of electrode-major [x_i[t],x_i[t-1]], t=1..479; both copies selected together
variants.hsic_rbf: R_ij=tr(H*K_i*H*H*K_j*H)/T^2 + eps*I; RBF sigma_i=median pairwise absolute differences per window/channel; eps=max(1e-12,1e-6*mean(diag(S)))
variants.envelope_oas: OAS covariance of abs(hilbert(band_filtered_X)), full 480-sample window

prior: Original mean(log(R_train)), fitted separately to the new R; weight=5; original cumulative log-Euclidean updater unchanged
protocol: 29 jobs per candidate: 24 LOSO, 3 later, 2 test; train-only fit for public test
test_policy: Three predeclared SPD representations; no lag/bandwidth/ridge/C tuning on public test
geometry_note: Only R(X) changes; inherited original SessionRecentering; delay copies are grouped by physical electrode
attribution: User-proposed representations, fixed one-delay/OAS adaptation; HSIC Gram is user-specified construction; envelope covariance is not full FUCONE
